svg.title: contentworker reference architecture, one customer deployment
svg.desc: Three kinds of client reach one customer deployment. Admin users sign in at the web Worker ①, which forwards their requests to the api Worker over the API service binding with a signed x-cw-principal header ②. API and MCP agents call the api directly with bearer tokens ③. The api commits each write to the D1 primary as one unit of work that includes an outbox row ④, then relays the outbox onto the contentworker-events queue in waitUntil ⑤. The engine Worker, which has no public route, consumes those events and runs webhooks, search and vector indexing and live fan-out ⑥, and enqueues purge tags that the delivery and media Workers drain against their own caches ⑦. Public delivery consumers call the delivery gateway with CDA or CPA keys; it authenticates every request from a KV-cached principal ⑧ and forwards a canonical URL keyed by visibility profile to the cached Delivery entrypoint, which reads a D1 read replica only on a miss ⑨. The engine alone writes the media gate in KV ⑩. The media gateway checks each published file URL's token and forwards it to the cached Media entrypoint, which reads the gate, the bytes from R2 and resized variants from Images ⑪. Uploads land in R2 through the api's signed PUT; R2's object-create notification feeds the asset-events queue, and the engine starts one AssetIngestWorkflow per file version, which calls Workers AI through AI Gateway and writes embeddings to Vectorize ⑫. The api and delivery Workers reach the engine's Durable Objects and Workflows through script_name bindings ⑬.
